contract.task_clause:
The fallacy of extension consists of
Option A: asking a question that includes either an unproven assumption or more than one question, thus making a straightforward yes or no answer meaningless.
Option B: arguing something is flawed because it doesn't do what it was never intended to do.
Option C: arguing about something when you don't know what you're talking about
Option D: including more than one claim in the proposition and treating proof for one claim as proof for all the claims.
